info.title: GeoAI Outdoor Activity Assistant API
info.description:
Recommends the best nearby place **and** time for outdoor activities using live OpenStreetMap, Open-Meteo and OSRM data, a deterministic safety-first ranking engine, and a self-hosted Qwen3-1.7B small language model (llama.cpp) for question understanding and explanations.

API version: `v1`. Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

get.summary: Readiness: model loaded and last-known provider status (no active probing)

post.summary: Recommend the best nearby place and time for an outdoor activity
post.description:
Synchronous endpoint. Typical latency on the CPU deployment is 20-70 s (live data + SLM).
Use `/api/v1/recommend/stream` to receive progress events and the ranking before the explanation.

post.summary: Same as /recommend, streamed as Server-Sent Events
post.description: Events: `stage` {stage, detail}; `ranking` (RecommendResponse without narrative); `done` (full RecommendResponse); `error` {code, message}.

note.title: Note
note.default: Contextual indicators derived from OpenStreetMap features; not a pollution or traffic measurement.

ExtractedIntent.title: ExtractedIntent
ExtractedIntent.description: What the SLM (or the rule-based fallback) extracts. Relative time only - never absolute timestamps.

IntentOverrides.title: IntentOverrides
IntentOverrides.description: Structured answers from the clarification UI. Any provided field wins over extraction.

radius_km.title: Radius Km
radius_km.description: Search radius; clamped to server maximum

origin.description: Explicit origin (e.g. browser geolocation with user consent)

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable id referenced by evidence values, e.g. 'weather:open-meteo'

examples.question: Where can I go running tomorrow morning near Powai?

requested_venue_id.title: Requested Venue Id
requested_venue_id.description: Set when the named place is itself a suitable venue; it is evaluated first.

safety_margin.title: Safety Margin
safety_margin.description: 0..1, distance from the nearest safety threshold

missing_policy.title: Missing Policy
missing_policy.default: Missing components are excluded and the total is reduced by 50% of their weight share.

name.title: Name
name.description: OSM name tag; null when unmapped (never invented)

display_label.title: Display Label
display_label.description: Name, or a deterministic descriptive label with the OSM id
